source.name: OmniSource
source.subtitle: A curated iOS app source for AltStore, SideStore, Feather, ESign and LiveContainer
source.description: OmniSource is a curated, automatically maintained AltStore-compatible iOS app source. Every entry is resolved from the app's own official upstream project - GitHub Releases or the developer's official AltStore feed - and each download link is re-verified automatically.

apps.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
apps.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
### New Features

- **library**: Add bit depth quality label mode
- **metadata**: Show explicit badges in track titles
- **library**: Support multiple storage folders
- **metadata**: Add download attribution to comments
- **metadata**: Edit release tags and render UPC barcodes
- **tagging**: Write release identity tags
- **extensions**: Preserve provider metadata
- **filename**: Add provider traceability tags
- **metadata**: Show embedded cover resolution (#510)
- **playlists**: Add play actions (#506) by [@Padma-Dev-E](https://github.com/Padma-Dev-E)
- **library**: Add combined quality label #511
- **metadata**: Review batch tag enrichment #511
- **logs**: Copy selected entries #511
- **search**: Save max-quality cover on long press #511
- **metadata**: Show cover dimensions and size #511
- **download**: Add automatic lossy conversion

### Bug Fixes

- **ios**: Handle library scan count output
- **player**: Smooth timed lyrics highlighting
- **library**: Show complete quality labels
- **analysis**: Reject false low spectral cutoffs
- **ui**: Align explicit badges with track titles
- **metadata**: Avoid duplicate explicit indicator
- **metadata**: Preserve explicit advisory across conversions
- **home**: Clear recent activity permanently
- **library**: Restore live folder scan progress
- **library**: Open folder actions on row tap
- **metadata**: Show readable SAF file locations
- **analysis**: Bound spectrogram memory for large files
- **metadata**: Preserve source release fields across providers
- **download**: Unblock queue after verification cancel
- **download**: Accept matching tracks across releases
- **ui**: Align metadata and wrap track badges
- **ui**: Update tutorial copy and library play button
- **library**: Preserve retained files during duplicate cleanup
- **metadata**: Keep collaboration albums grouped
- **download**: Normalize MP4 audio extension by codec (#512)
- **lyrics**: Use normalized Genius response (#517)
- **download**: Treat a short clean EOF as resumable, not complete by [@A831ARD0](https://github.com/A831ARD0)
- **playlists**: Thread the source provider id through to recent playlists by [@A831ARD0](https://github.com/A831ARD0)
- **ios**: Stop dropping the security-scoped download folder bookmark by [@A831ARD0](https://github.com/A831ARD0)
- **download**: Recover queue after worker timeout (#524)
- **playlist**: Ignore container title during album verification #519
- **metadata**: Match by primary artist and review results #511
- **lyrics**: Respect extension provider selection #511
- **metadata**: Honor provider priority in autofill #511
- **metadata**: Prompt verification during autofill #511
- **queue**: Restore user-paused downloads #511
- **cover**: Preserve best max-quality candidate #511
- **download**: Preserve SAF and defer background starts
- **db**: Prevent concurrent startup locks
- **a11y**: Label interactive controls

### Performance

- **library**: Stream scans and optimize queue queries
- **history**: Batch SAF orphan inspection #511

### Refactoring

- **metadata**: Move cover resolution to extensions
- **extensions**: Prioritize configurable settings

### Testing

- **audio**: Verify tagged PCM playback compatibility

### Dependencies

- **deps**: Bump locked Flutter dependencies
- **deps**: Update Flutter and Go dependencies

### Chores

- Update AltStore source to v4.8.5 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
- **analyzer**: Exclude platform folders from analysis
- **release**: Bump version to 4.9.0


### New Contributors
* @Padma-Dev-E made their first contribution



**Full Changelog**: [v4.8.5...v4.9.0](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v4.8.5...v4.9.0)

---

### Downloads

#### Android
- **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.0-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices)
- **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.0-arm32.apk` (older devices)

#### iOS
- **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.0-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)

### Installation
**Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK
**iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA

apps.name: uYouEnhanced
apps.subtitle: uYouPlus with even more features!
apps.localizedDescription: uYou is the best tweak for the YouTube app. uYouEnhanced is a modified version of qnblackcat's uYouPlus & MiRO92's uYou with even more features. Additional features include skipping sponsorships in videos, more PiP options, unlocking higher resolutions, disabling overlays, removing upsell alerts, dimming the UI, enabling the miniplayer, preventing notch issues, configuring A/B settings, and adding a timestamp button.

Once a 'Build uYouEnhanced' run publishes an IPA in this repository (tag uyouenhanced-v*), the self-built artifact takes over automatically.

apps.name: UTM
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Run real operating systems on your iPhone or iPad. UTM is an open-source (Apache-2.0) virtualization and emulation platform built on QEMU, capable of running Windows, Linux, classic Mac OS and dozens of other systems alongside your apps.

Highlights:
- QEMU v10.0.2 backend with support for dozens of CPU architectures (x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V, PowerPC and more)
- Improved machine wizard with well-tested configurations such as Windows, Ubuntu, RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x and Windows 95/98
- Custom keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Del) sent directly to the VM from the Keyboard menu
- App Intents automation with the Shortcuts app
- Liquid Glass design on iOS 26
- Import and export .utm virtual machine bundles via the Files app
- No jailbreak required; highest performance with JIT workarounds on supported iOS versions

compatibility.notes: Universal IPA. The QEMU (SE) backend runs on any iOS 14+ device; virtualization (HV) acceleration requires a supported device plus a JIT workaround or jailbreak. 4 GB of RAM or more is recommended for usable guest performance.

permissions.usageDescription: Permission is required for any virtual machine to record from the microphone.
UTM requests location data periodically to ensure the system keeps the background process active. Location data will never leave the device.

apps.name: Winston
apps.subtitle: Open-source Reddit client
apps.localizedDescription: Winston is a beautiful open-source Reddit client for iOS built in SwiftUI, with themes, gestures, an inline media viewer and a fast comment thread reader. Because Reddit charges for API access, Winston asks you to create your own free Reddit API credentials on first launch.

compatibility.notes: Official GPL-3.0 releases from lo-cafe/winston. The last published build is v1.1.5 (June 2024); the project is on hold, so treat it as archived-but-installable. Requires your own Reddit API credentials.

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.subtitle: Torrent client with a built-in player
apps.localizedDescription: iTorrent is a fully featured open-source torrent client for iOS. It keeps downloading in the background, integrates with the Files app, supports magnet links, sequential download and per-file selection, and ships a built-in VLC-based player with Picture in Picture, audio and subtitle tracks and playback speed control.

compatibility.notes: Official MIT-licensed releases from XITRIX/iTorrent.

apps.name: StikDebug
apps.subtitle: On-device JIT enabler and debugger
apps.localizedDescription: StikDebug attaches a debugger to your sideloaded apps directly on device, which enables JIT for emulators and other apps that need it. It uses a pairing file and an on-device VPN loop, so no computer is required after the initial setup. Requires iOS 17.4 or newer.

compatibility.notes: Official releases from StikDebug/StikDebug. Needs a pairing file and the on-device VPN loop; JIT attachment requires iOS 17.4 or newer.

apps.name: BHTwitter
apps.subtitle: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline
apps.localizedDescription: BHTwitter is a long-running tweak for X (formerly Twitter), published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides promoted posts and ads, restores the chronological timeline as the default, and lets you download videos, GIFs and images straight from a post. It also adds Face ID / Touch ID app lock, custom fonts, undo posting, inline translation, direct saving of profile pictures and headers, confirmation prompts for likes and reposts, and switches for hiding the tabs and UI elements you never use.

compatibility.notes: Official sideloaded build from BandarHL/BHTwitter. The release also ships a TrollStore .tipa, which OmniSource skips - only the -sideloaded.ipa is tracked. The bundled X app is whichever decrypted build the maintainer packaged for that tweak release.

apps.name: LiveContainer
apps.subtitle: Run iOS apps without actually installing them
apps.localizedDescription: LiveContainer runs other iOS apps inside itself instead of installing them, so a single app slot on your certificate can host many sideloaded apps and you stop burning through the 3-app limit. When JIT is available it bypasses codesigning entirely; otherwise guest apps are signed with the same certificate as LiveContainer. It supports multiple data containers per app, tweak injection, adding guest apps to the Home Screen, and multitasking windows on iPadOS 16 and later.

compatibility.notes: Official AGPL-3.0 releases. The plain LiveContainer.ipa is tracked; the LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa bundle in the same release is skipped. Multitasking needs iPadOS 16 or later, and installing guest apps needs AltStore 2.0+ / SideStore 0.6.0+.

apps.name: Feather
apps.subtitle: On-device app manager, signer and installer
apps.localizedDescription: Feather is a free on-device iOS and iPadOS application manager built with UIKit. Import your own developer or enterprise certificate to sign and install IPAs directly from the device, add AltStore-compatible repositories to browse and update apps, keep a library of signed and imported apps, and tweak bundle identifiers, display names, icons and injected dylibs per app - no computer or AltServer required.

compatibility.notes: Official GPL-3.0 releases from claration/Feather (formerly khcrysalis/Feather). You need your own signing certificate; Feather does not provide one.

apps.name: SideStore
apps.subtitle: AltStore fork that refreshes apps without a computer
apps.localizedDescription: SideStore is a fork of AltStore that signs and refreshes sideloaded apps directly on the device. After a one-time pairing-file setup it renews 7-day certificates in the background using your own Apple ID and an anisette server, so apps stop expiring while you are away from a computer. It installs apps from any AltStore-compatible source, keeps them updated, and can back up and restore app data.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SideStore can use local network access to discover Bonjour (mDNS) services on your network. This is not required for core functionality.

compatibility.notes: Official AGPL-3.0 stable releases; the rolling nightly and alpha tags are pre-releases and are not tracked. Requires a pairing file and, on iOS 17+, a JIT/StikDebug-style enabler for some features.

apps.name: Aidoku
apps.subtitle: Free and open-source manga reader
apps.localizedDescription: Aidoku is a free and open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS with no ads and no tracking. Content comes from community-maintained source lists that you add yourself, so nothing is bundled with the app. It downloads chapters for offline reading, syncs library, history and settings through iCloud, supports external trackers, and offers paged, vertical and continuous reading modes with customisable layouts.

compatibility.notes: Official releases from Aidoku/Aidoku. Sources are added by the user; the app ships none.

apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: Multi-system retro game emulator
apps.localizedDescription: Provenance is a multi-emulator front-end covering Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony systems from a single library. It handles save states, cheats, MFi and native game controllers, Metal-based scaling filters, per-core settings, and imports your own ROMs and BIOS files through the Files app, iCloud or its built-in web uploader.

compatibility.notes: Official stable releases; the rolling alpha tag is a pre-release and is not tracked. The iOS IPA is around 1 GB because every emulator core is bundled, and the tvOS build is skipped. Provenance ships no games - you supply your own ROMs.
